raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Customers migrated to the new CRM on 2026-01-15 carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') in place of region names. silver_customers passes these codes through unchanged, so gold_region_daily ends up with code-labelled rows. raw_region_map covers all four codes and maps each one to an existing region name, so the correct values can be derived exactly.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(COALESCE(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON trim(c.region) = trim(m.region_code)"}}
